1: // Simple Space Debris Dodge game
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
9: 
10:   // Game state
11:   const ship = { x: width / 2, y: height * 0.8, w: 30, h: 15, speed: 0, fuel: 100 };
12:   const debris = [];
13:   const packets = [];
14:   let score = 0;
15:   let lastTime = 0;
16: 
17:   // Helpers
18:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
19:   const spawnDebris = () => {
20:     const size = rand(15, 40);
21:     debris.push({ x: rand(0, width), y: -size, r: size, angle: rand(0, Math.PI * 2), rot: rand(-0.05, 0.05) });
22:   };
23:   const spawnPacket = () => {
24:     const size = 10;
25:     packets.push({ x: rand(0, width), y: -size, r: size });
26:   };
27:   const rectCollide = (a, b) => a.x < b.x + b.r && a.x + a.w > b.x - b.r && a.y < b.y + b.r && a.y + a.h > b.y - b.r;
28: 
29:   // Input
30:   const keys = {};
31:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.code] = true; });
32:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; });
33: 
34:   function update(dt) {
35:     // Fuel drains
36:     ship.fuel -= dt * 0.01; // drain per ms
37:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) ship.fuel = 0;
38: 
39:     // Horizontal thrust
40:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA']) ship.x -= ship.speed * dt;
41:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD']) ship.x += ship.speed * dt;
42:     // Apply constant forward speed (visual only)
43:     ship.speed = 0.2; // pixels per ms
44:     // Clamp ship inside canvas
45:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x));
46: 
47:     // Move debris downwards
48:     debris.forEach(d => {
49:       d.y += ship.speed * dt * 0.5; // slower than ship to simulate forward motion
50:       d.angle += d.rot;
51:     });
52:     // Move packets downwards
53:     packets.forEach(p => p.y += ship.speed * dt * 0.5);
54: 
55:     // Remove off‑screen objects
56:     while (debris.length && debris[0].y - debris[0].r > height) debris.shift();
57:     while (packets.length && packets[0].y - packets[0].r > height) packets.shift();
58: 
59:     // Spawn new obstacles / packets
60:     if (Math.random() < dt * 0.0015) spawnDebris();
61:     if (Math.random() < dt * 0.0008) spawnPacket();
62: 
63:     // Collision detection
64:     for (let i = debris.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
65:       if (rectCollide(ship, debris[i])) {
66:         // Game over – stop animation
67:         cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
68:         alert(`Game Over! Score: ${score}`);
69:         return false;
70:       }
71:     }
72:     for (let i = packets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
73:       if (rectCollide(ship, packets[i])) {
74:         score += 10;
75:         packets.splice(i, 1);
76:       }
77:     }
78:     return true;
79:   }
80: 
81:   function draw() {
82:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
83:     // Ship (simple triangle)
84:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
85:     ctx.beginPath();
86:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y);
87:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y);
88:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y - ship.h);
89:     ctx.closePath();
90:     ctx.fill();
91:     // Debris (rotating squares)
92:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
93:     debris.forEach(d => {
94:       ctx.save();
95:       ctx.translate(d.x, d.y);
96:       ctx.rotate(d.angle);
97:       ctx.fillRect(-d.r / 2, -d.r / 2, d.r, d.r);
98:       ctx.restore();
99:     });
100:     // Packets (blue circles)
101:     ctx.fillStyle = '#00f';
102:     packets.forEach(p => {
103:       ctx.beginPath();
104:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
105:       ctx.fill();
106:     });
107:     // HUD
108:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
109:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
110:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
111:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.floor(ship.fuel)}`, 10, 40);
112:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) {
113:       ctx.fillText('Out of fuel!', width / 2 - 50, height / 2);
114:     }
115:   }
116: 
117:   let animId;
118:   function loop(timestamp) {
119:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
120:     lastTime = timestamp;
121:     if (update(dt)) {
122:       draw();
123:       animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
124:     }
125:   }
126:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
127: })();
